name: Database Query Tool
description: Use this tool to retrieve, filter, or sort your grocery purchase records based on specific criteria such as store, category, price range, or date. Always provide a value for every field. If the user does not specify a value for a filter, you must use the 'Default Value' listed in the input schema to ensure the search remains unrestricted. Perfect for questions like 'How much did I spend at Kaufland in January?', 'List all items in the Pantry category', or 'What were my most expensive purchases?'.

inputs.name: store
inputs.description: The store name. If not specified, use 'ALL'.

inputs.name: category
inputs.description: The product category. Must be one of: Fruits & Vegetables, Bakery, Dairy & Eggs, Meat, Cold Cuts & Fish, Beverages, Pantry & Dry Goods, Frozen & Chilled, Sweets & Snacks, Breakfast & Spreads, Household & Personal Care, Pet Food, Organic & Health, International, Pfand & Deposits, Discounts. If not specified, use 'ALL'.

inputs.name: min_price
inputs.description: Min total_price. Use '0' if not specified.

inputs.name: max_price
inputs.description: Max total_price. Use '99999' if not specified.

inputs.name: start_date
inputs.description: Start date (YYYY-MM-DD). If not specified, use '1900-01-01'.

inputs.name: end_date
inputs.description: End date (YYYY-MM-DD). If not specified, use '2099-12-31'.

inputs.name: sort_by
inputs.description: Field to sort by. If not specified, use 'purchase_date'.

inputs.name: sort_order
inputs.description: Order of sort. Use 'asc' or 'desc'. If not specified, use 'desc'.
